name: Matomo Reports
description: Display analytics reports from Matomo server.

suggests.drupal/matomo: Provides the Matomo tracking snippet and shared server settings (url_http/url_https, site_id) reused by the reports block.

project_description:
This module makes some of the Matomo web analytics reports available in your Drupal site. 

 Matomo Reports was formerly a submodule of Piwik Web analytics module (which is now available as Matomo Analytics module ) and originally created as Piwik Reports by xlyz .

 Features :

 
 global or per user token auth 
 multiple sites report allowed 
 block for in page statistics 
 
 Versions :

 8.x-1.x works for Piwik >= 2.10 and Matomo >= 3.3.0.

 For Drupal 7 support, see the Piwik Reports module .

 Development was originally sponsored by Relinc for the Piwik Reports module.
